extras: Requires turning off 'Readable line length' in Obsidian Editor settings to prevent layout issues.
intentEvidence: Built to replace Dataview-based character sheets: instead of dataviewjs blocks re-rendering on every metadata change, this plugin uses its own MarkdownRenderChild-based code block processors
motivation: To provide a fast, interactive character sheet experience that avoids the performance issues of Dataview-based solutions.
problem: Existing character sheets often rely on complex Dataview setups that cause performance issues and slow re-rendering when metadata changes.

relations.evidence: This plugin's sheet relies on two other community plugins to actually render correctly

Atlas VTT support: characters show up in Atlas VTT as statblocks

summary: A character sheet plugin that renders a fully interactive D&D 2024 character sheet inside Obsidian, styled like D&D Beyond.
